reply_text: Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail), not Pellucid Harbor Logistics. I've replied in #coastal-team. Kwame and you settled this on Feb 17: PHL means Pellow for the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, and Pellucid for the Gulf Coast terminal rows. Both accounts use the PHL code, so check the full account name when you file tickets.
